task: Scan the handwritten homework from the file 'homework.jpg' and convert it into an editable Word document named 'homework.docx', then export the resulting Word file as a PDF named 'new_homework.pdf'. Make sure the Word file contains the transcribed content from the homework image before generating the PDF.
query_sentence: Scan the homework and save the word file as a PDF.

ground_truth_memory.fact: The image file homework.jpg contains the user's homework that needs to be digitized.

ground_truth_memory.action_item: Use OCR to transcribe the content from homework.jpg into an editable Word document named homework.docx.
After creating homework.docx, export this Word document as a PDF file named new_homework.pdf.
